newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi imported 3.5 mln T barley in 10 months - paper.
newsitem.headline: Saudi imported 3.5 mln T barley in 10 months - paper.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has imported 3.5 million tonnes of barley in the last 10 months and imports are expected to rise to four million tonnes by the end of the year, a Saudi newspaper reported on Tuesday.
Al-Eqtisadiah quoted Mohammad Bakr, head of the Saudi Ports Authority, as saying that 3.5 million tonnes of barley had been unloaded at Saudi ports in the last 10 months.
"It is expected that the amount will increase to four million tonnes by the end of the year," the paper said.
Saudi Arabia traditionally buys about 40 percent of the world's feed barley supply, making it the largest world buyer.
Canadian Wheat Board market analyst Larry Sawatzky said on Monday world feed barley prices had stabilised in the last month on firm Saudi import demand.
He said Saudi Arabia was projected to import about five million tonnes of barley which would account for 50 percent of world feed barley trade.
